name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.introduce.SpeechVoiceQuestionFullIntroduceActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects a full-screen question introduction. It shows the advertiser's question and answers alongside its voice and image material.
disableEffect: This interactive ad introduction and its associated viewing reward will no longer be available.
